name.zh: 把有限产能分给持续项目

summary.zh: 投入不会立刻消失，但被一个项目占用，就不能同时加速另一个。
summary.en: Assigned capacity is not immediately consumed, but one project cannot use capacity committed elsewhere.

rules.zh: 玩家把有限的可分配资源投入多个持续推进的项目。投入越多通常越快，但单项可能存在速度上限；资源可抽回再分配。玩家比较进度条和收益，决定集中冲完一项，还是让多项同时推进。
rules.en: Assign a limited pool of capacity to ongoing projects. More allocation usually speeds progress, but individual projects may have a speed cap. Capacity can be withdrawn and reassigned. Compare progress and rewards to choose focused completion or parallel growth.

loop.zh: 抽回多余投入重新分配

decisions.zh: 把所有资源投给短期急需的项目，还是让长期项目也不停工？
decisions.en: Concentrate on an urgent project or keep long-term projects progressing?

decisions.zh: 某项已经达到最快速度，继续留资源是省操作，还是浪费机会？
decisions.en: If a project is already at maximum speed, is leaving capacity there convenient or wasteful?

effect.zh: 线性关系容易估计；有上限或递减收益会鼓励重新分配。
effect.en: A linear relationship is easy to estimate; caps or diminishing returns encourage reassignment.

effect.zh: 自由调配支持随时优化；冷却或进度损失会让承诺更重要。
effect.en: Free reassignment supports continuous optimization; cooldowns or lost progress make commitment matter.

implementation.zh: Energy和Magic可分配到不同训练、增强和NGU等功能中，让相应进度推进；分配到一处的资源暂时不能用于别处。
implementation.en: Energy and Magic can be assigned to training, augments, NGUs and other features to advance their progress; assigned resources are unavailable elsewhere.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：冒险战斗与角色数值可见；这张图没有打开能量分配面板。
observation.en: System reference: Adventure combat and character values are visible; the energy-allocation panel is not open. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 影分身可分派到身体训练与技能训练；每项训练有达到最快速度所需的分身数量，玩家可用Cap辅助分配。
implementation.en: Shadow clones can train physical and skill exercises. Each training has a clone requirement for its fastest rate, and the Cap control helps allocate that amount.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：战斗画面与角色数值可见；这张图没有展示容量重新分配。
observation.en: System reference: Combat and character values are visible; capacity reassignment is not shown. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: NGU把可分配能力用于多种长期功能；放置成神把它表现成可派遣分身，并用训练速度上限提示多余投入。
contrast.en: NGU distributes capacity across many long-term features; Idling to Rule the Gods represents it as clones and exposes training caps that reveal excess allocation.

combination.zh: 组合提案：允许设置“此项目完成后，把产能转到下一项”的条件，先让玩家手动理解分配，再解锁自动交接。
combination.en: Design proposal: let players set a condition that moves capacity to the next project on completion, after they first understand manual allocation.

setup.zh: 有10点产能，项目A差20进度完成，项目B刚开始；每点产能每轮加1进度。
setup.en: Ten capacity points are available. A needs twenty progress; B has just begun. Each point adds one progress per round.

action.en: Assign all ten points to A.

result.zh: 两轮后A完成，10点产能释放。
result.en: A completes after two rounds, releasing all ten points.

next.zh: 把产能转给B，或为新解锁的项目C留一部分。
next.en: Move capacity to B or reserve some for newly unlocked C.

firstStep.zh: 做两条进度条、一个总量固定的资源池和加减分配按钮。
firstStep.en: Build two progress bars, one fixed capacity pool and allocation controls.

pitfall.zh: 要清楚区分“消耗掉”和“暂时占用”，否则玩家不敢调整。
pitfall.en: Clearly distinguish spent resources from temporarily assigned capacity so players feel able to reallocate.

test.zh: 玩家是否会在项目接近上限或完成时主动回收多余产能？
test.en: Do players reclaim excess capacity near a cap or completion?
